message.reasoning:
Let me evaluate against rubric criteria.

C1: Mission concept & rationale. Clear description: coral reef monitoring satellite for GBR, users: marine/conservation scientists, benefits. Good rationale with statistics and references. But mission objectives/requirements not quantified (no resolution, revisit, orbit specifics, payload spec). Still strong. Accomplished level 7-10. Give 8.

C2: Project plan. Gantt chart included with tasks and timeline, task descriptions, contingency? Not much provision for variations/contingencies; plan fits mission narrative somewhat. Information sources listed. Adequate-Accomplished. Gantt labels "gold/blue" but image is yellow/blue — minor. Plan lacks explicit contingency. I'd give Adequate high or Accomplished low. The Gantt is detailed with tasks covering launch, orbit, comms, EOL, STK. But no explicit contingency and weak link between mission concept and plan. Give 7? Perhaps 6. Let's think: rubric Accomplished requires robust plan with provision for variations and contingencies AND fits narrative with why plan developed this way, references to information sources. This plan is decent but lacks contingencies. Adequate: plan presented but lacks some detail, enough to believe feasible. I'd say Adequate upper: 6.

C3: Preliminary progress. Evidence: read Asner system, researched bleaching, completed STK tutorials 1-4. That's minor work; no actual results. Adequate = minor work completed, results description insufficient. Give 4.

C4: Presentation. Structured headings, clear writing, references numbered footnotes and list; figures labelled (Gantt). Reference list as raw links, inconsistent citation style (footnote numbers vs list). Writing good. Accomplished-Adequate. Some issues: "Useful Links" list plain URLs, no proper citation format, "STK Design & Simulations" row described under gy; also typo "Launch Specifics" (their own). Formatting decent. Give 8? Perhaps 7. Link between in-text and list: footnotes 1-4 match URLs; list includes extra sources. Mostly consistent. Give 8.

Requirements:
R1 met.
R2: plan relates to space segment (launch, orbit, comms) yes, mentions astrodynamics, COEs — but no actual orbit/launch analysis yet. Partial? Plan includes launch & orbit tasks, applying course material (astrodynamics mention). I'd say partial (plan doesn't yet apply material, only lists tasks). Hmm requirement says "Relate the preliminary plan to the mission's space segment, applying relevant course material such as launch and orbits." The plan includes launch/orbit stages but no applied analysis. Partial.
R3: STK selected, yes met (STK is allowed).
R4 met.
R5 met.
R6: partial — only tutorial completion and background reading, no technical content. Partial.

Technical issues: no orbit/altitude/resolution requirements; pH "30 percent more acidic" — actually ocean acidification ~30% increase in H+ concentration is correct (pH drop 0.1 = 26-30% increase in acidity), fine. Bathymetry resolution 100 m. Gantt colour legend mismatch (says gold/blue, chart yellow) minor. Gantt shows Wk2-Wk10 while project; deadline red line at wk3/week4 boundary — "completed stages gold" but background research continues. Also Gantt row "STK Design & Simulations" described under one bullet. Timeline: report due 20/11/20 (Wk 10 16/11). Fine. Mission concept lacks payload/sensor specification and coverage/revisit requirements — key technical issue. No cost/launch vehicle.

Overall.

Marks: C1 8, C2 6, C3 4, C4 8.
